title: I’ve been to every kind of event over decades. I prefer events that are not too exclusive or dumbmonied. Exclusive events mean I can’t hang with pals. Also tbqh, some exclusive sports events often feel sausage party flat and corporate and less fun. I will never shake the memory of being a broke broke broke sports fan. And also the memories of cool people giving me free/discounted tickets. I hate seeing empty corporate seats or flat energy stadiums. Don’t like any marketing or process that makes me feel broke even when I’m not, or pretends I should be impressed with exclusion. Where the tech/process makes me feel bad it is just a wallet extraction tech, and less care is given to people with less money. I’m very Houston ice house so though I have big fun at fancy parties, I’m big happy at ice houses too. Like teams should have every kind of experience for every kind of fan for sure, and watch parties rule. Just don’t like my face rubbed in the idea I should be impressed by money ish. One of my best times early this year was the Texans watch party for the Patriots road game. Yeah the game went bad quickly. Hard to hide issues against playoff defenses on the road. But it was cool seeing Reliant that way. Very very energized crowd despite few prompts to be that way. I sat in Joe Texan’s old Bull Pen seat with a great sightline to the end zone screens. He would have figured out a way to be at the game in person because he was a @TravelingTexans king, before we gave it a name. Loved him so much, he was so fun and encouraging. RIP 😭 Because it was free, there were a lot of kids being in the building for the first time. A coach brought his team of little kids, they sat behind me and were super fun. Always want kids to have cool times, fans for life. We talked some about football stuff, a lot about WAJ and SWARM and silly stuff. It’s interesting to me to find out what kids and adults know and don’t know about football. I gave them some trinket giveaway stuff I don’t need. We did rock paper scissors for different items. It truly was uplifting to be around fans happy to be around fans. Was super grateful to be around some fun kids where we talked about rooting for your team when they are struggling and sports losses. Losing games is supposed to be a way to model dealing with actual life adversity. Nice to be around well coached kids who were more mature about it than some adults I know, who were their worst selves after that loss. 😂 Watch parties for everybody >>>>>>>>
